title: Ovid2 domain pack manifest
description: One domain pack (`pack.yaml`). A pack bundles a target data model (CDM YAML trees), declarative data-health checks and report-cycle packages, semantic vocabularies and column bindings, Report Studio templates, remediation hints and — for installed Python packs only — check operators and fixers. Built-in packs live under `src/ovid2/resources/packs/<id>/` and describe content that ships in the core tree (`provides.members`); installed packs are Python distributions registered under the `ovid2.packs` entry-point group; folder packs are YAML-only directories under `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/ovid2/packs/<id>/`. Every name a non-built-in pack contributes is namespaced by its id. ADR: .opencode/knowledge/delta/adr-domain-packs.md.

rel_dir.description: Directory relative to the pack root (no absolute paths, no `..`).

summary.description: One-line summary. Must equal the first docstring line of the fixer class (pinned by tests/contract/test_fixers_catalogue_synchronised.py).

scope.description: `generic` or the CDM name the fixer is restricted to.

aliases.description: Named-field aliases for the positional `src1` / `src2` slots.

column_roles.description: Which columns the fixer touches (grammar: ovid2.config.column_roles). Drives the pipeline navigator.

id.description: Stable pack id. Prefix for every name the pack contributes: `<id>` / `<id>_…` for CDMs, fixers, operators and parts; `<id>.…` for check ids, check packages, vocabularies and report templates.

label.description: Human label shown in pickers and on /packs.

requires_ovid2.description: Comma-separated version constraints on the Ovid2 release (`>=0.1`, `<1.0`, `==0.1.0`). A pack whose constraint fails stays inactive.

cdms.description: CDM names. Installed / folder packs ship `cdms/<name>/` (the C1 YAML tree layout); built-in packs name CDMs that ship in core.

report_templates_dir.description: Directory laid out as `<source_kind>/<stem>.yaml` (Report Studio templates for an existing report-source kind).

parts.description: Extra check `part` buckets the pack's checks may use (ordered after the core parts).

operators_module.description: Installed packs only. Module (inside the pack's package) whose import registers health-check operators via `@operator`. Executor tier only.

fixers_module.description: Installed packs only. Module exposing `FIXERS: dict[str, type[BaseFixer]]`. Executor tier only.

fixers.description: Web-safe metadata for every fixer in `fixers_module` (the web tier never imports pack code).

members.description: Built-in packs only: core content this pack owns (attribution on /packs, list endpoints and reports).
